beats.text: If you have ADHD, stop doing fifty-two week savings challenges.
beats.why: 'Stop…' imperative + strike-the-old-way. @adhd_chatter_podcast 'Stop trusting your memory' 383.8k views, 24.7k saves (6.4%). Names the exact product category buyers already pay for (savings challenges: 2,376 / 2,286 / 1,049 review listings).

beats.text: You're obsessed for one week. By week three, the tracker is lost in a drawer.
Do a sprint instead. Seven, fourteen, or thirty days.
beats.why: Re-hook at ~7s: the fix, in three numbers.

beats.text: Save the amount on any bubble, color it in, and watch it fill up.
beats.why: Watch-it-fill format: '100 envelope challenge' 2.8M views, 22.5k saves; 'Color an icon each time you save' 202.5k views.

beats.text: There are twelve, from a fifty dollar weekend warm up, to your first thousand dollar emergency fund.
beats.why: Show the whole product: real tracker pages.

beats.text: Every bubble adds up exactly to the goal. Print it, use it on your iPad, or in the spreadsheet.
beats.why: Intensifier + objection handling (format). Spreadsheet demos save at 1.87% median, 9.5% top.

beats.text: Save this, and start the fifty dollar one this weekend. It's called Savings Sprints. It's in my bio.
beats.why: Save prompt + tiny first step + exact product name.
